sources.title: GitHub - sherinnn/LLM-Architecture: GPT-2 (124M parameters) from ...
sources.snippet: This project walks through building a GPT-2 style language model (124M parameters) completely from scratch and using it to generate text autoregressively. It follows two major stages: Model Construction — Implementing the GPT-2 architecture Text Generation — Using the model to predict and generate tokens
